register.labelZh: CHOP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: CHOP 片語動詞能幫助你分辨反覆劈砍、把整棵樹砍倒，以及只砍掉其中一部分。；你可以使用這些表達來描述砍削樹根、清理茂密植物，以及移除不安全的樹木或樹枝。；chop something off 可以表示在烹調食物前，砍掉頂部、末端或其他不需要的部分。；這些 CHOP 表達經常出現在故事、戶外工作指示，以及有關樹木、小路和損壞物件的報道中。
register.summaryEn: The CHOP family helps you distinguish between repeated cutting, making a whole tree fall and removing only one part. You can use these expressions to describe cutting roots, clearing thick plants and removing unsafe trees or branches. Chop something off can describe removing the top, end or other unwanted part of food before cooking it. These CHOP expressions often appear in stories, outdoor instructions and reports about trees, paths and damaged objects.
